architecture_layers.name: Static Analysis Fixtures
architecture_layers.responsibility: Intentionally unreferenced package files that provide dead-code and orphan-symbol cases for static-analysis evaluation.

architecture_layers.name: Core Domain and Workflows
architecture_layers.responsibility: Animal abstractions, profile and configuration models, domain services, and workflow composition for the sample application.

architecture_layers.name: Application Entry
architecture_layers.responsibility: The executable integration entry point that drives the sample's core services, models, and composed pipelines.

architecture_layers.name: Shared Utilities
architecture_layers.responsibility: Dependency-free arithmetic, clamping, and name-formatting helpers together with the utility package's public exports.

components.name: Application Orchestration and Service Invocation
components.responsibility: Owns executable startup, construction of shared inputs, and service-level invocation semantics, including the decorator and closure mechanism that may wrap service calls.

relations.description: Fact-level calls cross these component boundaries.
relations.label: Calls

relations.description: `main.main` constructs/enriches profiles through the service facade, then consumes both aggregate-derived summary data and pipeline-derived profile views. The exchange is entirely in-memory; `UserProfile` instances and summary/city values cross the boundary.
relations.label: orchestrates profile lifecycle and reads profile views

relations.description: `main.main` invokes the query facade and consumes its terminal dictionary result. Internally, `build_query` coordinates a fluent sequence over one mutable `QueryBuilder`; no database, network, or external query executor participates in this relation.
relations.label: requests an in-memory query representation

relations.description: `main.main` creates concrete animal instances, submits collections to `process_animals`, and invokes dispatch-oriented workflows. `process_animals` communicates through the `Animal.speak` abstraction with runtime subtype resolution; `dispatch` additionally selects a handler from the mutable exact-type `HANDLERS` registry, making it an intentional plugin/extension hook.
relations.label: constructs animal inputs and exercises polymorphic dispatch

relations.description: Fact-level calls cross these component boundaries.
relations.label: Calls

relations.description: `main.main` supplies scalar and collection inputs to the computation APIs and consumes their returned values. In addition to direct service calls, it invokes the closure returned by `make_multiplier(2)`, which captures its factor lexically and is therefore a runtime callback-style communication path rather than a module-level static target.
relations.label: invokes calculation and collection-transformation scenarios

interpretations.claim: The two __init__.py files define which core and utility names are re-exported as package-level APIs. They are easy to overlook because they contain little behavior, but changing these files can change how callers import otherwise unchanged implementations.
interpretations.title: Package Surfaces

interpretations.claim: pipeline.py has the highest fan-out in the graph and combines dispatch, fluent query construction, generators, factories, and functional transformations. Read it after the domain and service layers so each composed operation has an already-known input and dependency.
interpretations.title: Composition Pipeline

interpretations.claim: services.py turns the domain objects from the previous step into small operations for creation, transformation, bounded arithmetic, and configuration access. It also concentrates several Python implementation techniques, making it a useful bridge from data definitions to executable behavior.
interpretations.title: Domain Services

interpretations.claim: helpers.py sits at depth two from main.py and is reused by both services and the pipeline. Its arithmetic, clamping, and formatting helpers are deliberately dependency-free, illustrating how a small foundational module can support several higher-level paths without depending on them.
interpretations.title: Utility Foundation

interpretations.claim: Next establish the objects that the rest of the sample manipulates. base.py defines the animal hierarchy and models.py defines configuration and profile data, so together they supply the contracts used by both services and pipelines.
interpretations.title: Domain Vocabulary

interpretations.claim: Finish with the unused package, which is intentionally disconnected from the execution path that starts at main.py. Comparing its real symbols with its zero import reachability shows why file coverage, symbol extraction, and runtime relevance are different measurements.
interpretations.title: Orphan Code Detection

interpretations.claim: Start with main.py because it is the real execution entry point and the only file that directly reaches all four core modules. Its imports and calls provide a compact map of the sample before you study the individual language features.
interpretations.title: Executable Overview

attributes.implementation: main.main 位于事实调用关系的高连接位置。
attributes.problem: 新人容易只看到单个函数，却看不出哪个入口把多个职责串起来。
attributes.tradeoffs: 中心节点便于建立调用链，但不能单独证明运行时一定会走到它。
attributes.transfer_conditions: 遇到事件处理器、请求入口或任务调度器时，先找高连接节点再核对调用点。

interpretations.claim: main.main 连接了 20 条静态关系。
interpretations.title: 关键路径如何编排多个模块

attributes.problem: 修改一个共享模块可能影响多个上层组件，必须沿依赖边界评估风险。
attributes.tradeoffs: 导入关系说明静态依赖，不等于所有调用都在运行时发生。
attributes.transfer_conditions: 做重构或首次贡献时，从共享依赖的入度和证据位置开始检查测试范围。

interpretations.claim: 这条导入边是可直接核对的依赖证据。
interpretations.title: 依赖边界决定修改影响

attributes.implementation: core/base.py 中的 __init__ 没有静态调用或导入连接。
attributes.problem: 只看文件列表会把未连接代码误认为主流程。
attributes.tradeoffs: 静态图不能证明代码永远不会被反射、插件或外部入口调用。
attributes.transfer_conditions: 调试大型仓库时，区分“存在”“被引用”和“被运行”三个层次。
